milestones.name: deterministic-validity
milestones.evidence: The exact statement, axioms, formalization and checker result pass the frozen deterministic validity policy.

milestones.name: independent-reproduction
milestones.evidence: Effectively independent controllers reproduce the result across the frozen implementation and environment roots.

milestones.name: adversarial-survival
milestones.evidence: The result survives the frozen falsifier suite and a bounded public challenge, or is honestly disproved.

milestones.name: independent-downstream-use
milestones.evidence: An independently controlled downstream artifact reuses the result without circular authorship or funding.

milestones.name: maintained-recheck
milestones.evidence: The artifact remains reproducible across the prospectively declared maintenance interval or toolchain change.

nodes.title: Finite algebra and lattice construction
nodes.summary: Build exact arguments over finite fields, modules, lattices and polynomial rings without hiding parameter or representation assumptions.
artifacts: A statement with exact fields, rings, modules, lattices, parameters and excluded degenerate cases.
A proof or counterexample with machine-checkable finite computations where used.
A dependency manifest separating imported algebraic lemmas from novel steps.

nodes.title: Analysis and geometry construction
nodes.summary: Control limits, regularity, measure, topology and geometric hypotheses with explicit domains and failure cases.
artifacts: A theorem statement pinning domains, regularity, boundary conditions and exceptional sets.
A proof or counterexample that exposes every compactness, convergence and measurability dependency.
Numerical illustrations labelled as evidence rather than proof.

nodes.title: Combinatorics and discrete structure
nodes.summary: Construct and falsify finite, graph, extremal and discrete arguments with auditable enumeration boundaries.
artifacts: A canonical object encoding and symmetry-reduction rule.
A proof, construction or counterexample with bounded enumeration where applicable.
Independent small-instance checks that cannot be confused with a general proof.

nodes.title: Counterexamples and falsification
nodes.summary: Search for the smallest honest obstruction and preserve a negative result as first-class constructive work.
artifacts: A frozen claim or lemma target and the exact assumption set under attack.
A minimized counterexample or a bounded no-counterexample-found report.
A deterministic falsifier suite with seed, bounds and oracle digest.

nodes.title: Formalization and trusted kernels
nodes.summary: Translate prose mathematics into explicit terms while disclosing axioms, trusted kernels, admits and semantic gaps.
artifacts: A formal statement mapped line by line to the frozen human-readable statement.
A complete axiom, admit, plugin and trusted-code-base inventory.
A reproducible checker environment identified by exact artifact digests.

nodes.title: Logic, definitions and semantic hygiene
nodes.summary: Make quantifiers, definitions, equivalence notions and admissible inference explicit before difficulty or novelty is scored.
artifacts: A typed glossary with quantified variables and exact equality or equivalence notions.
An assumption ledger distinguishing definitions, axioms, conjectures and imported theorems.
At least one boundary or degenerate case that tests the statement's intended meaning.

nodes.title: Independent proof and reproduction
nodes.summary: Distinguish a genuinely independent derivation from a transcription, shared implementation or correlated review.
artifacts: Control, funding, implementation, toolchain and environment cluster disclosures.
An independent derivation or checker replay produced after the artifact freeze.
A disagreement log that preserves good-faith negative evidence.

nodes.title: Multi-kernel proof assurance
nodes.summary: Reduce one-kernel common-mode risk through independently rooted checking or a reviewed semantic translation.
artifacts: At least two independently rooted checker or kernel digests.
A reviewed translation or shared-semantics statement between formalizations.
A disclosed common-mode analysis for parser, elaborator, kernel and hardware roots.

nodes.title: Optimization and numerical evidence
nodes.summary: Separate exact claims from approximation, conditioning, convergence and empirical solver behavior.
artifacts: An objective, feasible region and approximation or convergence guarantee with explicit norms.
Conditioning, precision, stopping and failure criteria pinned before execution.
Reproducible solver traces that never masquerade as proof beyond their declared bounds.

nodes.title: Prior art and semantic roots
nodes.summary: Freeze what problem is actually being solved so paraphrase, lemma splitting and moving baselines cannot manufacture novelty.
artifacts: A content digest for the statement, definitions and admissible transformations.
A dated prior-art manifest with search bounds and independently challengeable omissions.
A semantic-root rule that clusters equivalent restatements before any score or budget.

nodes.title: Probability and stochastic construction
nodes.summary: Reason about randomness, information, dependence and asymptotics with the probability space and conditioning made explicit.
artifacts: An explicit probability space, filtration or dependence model and all limiting regimes.
A proof or counterexample separating exact bounds from simulation evidence.
Calibrated computational checks with frozen seeds and uncertainty reporting.

nodes.title: Reproducible mathematical computation
nodes.summary: Bind computational evidence to exact code, data, environment, precision and declared logical role.
artifacts: Content-addressed source, inputs, outputs and environment.
Deterministic seeds or an explicit entropy transcript.
A statement of whether the computation proves, falsifies, illustrates or only searches.

nodes.title: Frontier quest: formal construction
nodes.summary: Prove, disprove or formally implement one frozen mathematical claim, then survive independent reproduction, falsification and downstream use.
artifacts: A complete problem packet binding the exact statement, formalization, axioms, semantic root and prior-art cutoff.
Deterministic validity evidence plus independently controlled reproduction.
A falsifier suite, challenge record and independently controlled downstream-use receipt.
